subject: Using 'require(RMySQL)' in a rapache page causes warnings.

messages.author: 9b8e33e6f9d197ef
messages.subject: Using 'require(RMySQL)' in a rapache page causes warnings.
parts:
I have rapache working and can visit a page like
http://127.0.0.1/testSendBin.png?id=10 and see a plot with 10 random
points on it.
That page is made with this .r file:

setContentType("image/png")
t <- tempfile()
#id = 3
id <- GET$id
png(t,type="cairo")
plot(rnorm(id))
dev.off()
sendBin(readBin(t,'raw',n=file.info(t)$size))
unlink(t)
DONE

I want to source my data for the plot from a MySQL database so I have
installed RMySQL. That's tested and works fine, plotting too, when I
run R in interactive mode.

However, if I add the line:
require(RMySQL)
to the above file I get a warning prepended to my *.png. You can see
the resultant page source here: http://pastebin.com/8jELWpj7
That's basically a png image prepended with
"RApache Warning/Error!!!
Loading required package: RMySQL
RApache Warning/Error!!!
Loading required package: DBI"

Why is it warning me instead of just loading RMySQL as happens when I
run R from the command line?

messages.author: 9b8e33e6f9d197ef
messages.subject: Re: Using 'require(RMySQL)' in a rapache page causes warnings.
parts:
To make this a into a simpler example, I removed ROutputErrors from my
apache2.conf to route the error to /var/log/apache2/error.log.

This is the error I get:

[Thu Apr 15 15:33:27 2010] [error] [client 10.64.74.13] Loading
required package: RMySQL\n
[Thu Apr 15 15:33:27 2010] [error] [client 10.64.74.13] Loading
required package: DBI\n

It's almost as if the instance of R that Rapache is running is a
different version, one without RMySQL, to the version that gets run
when I type R at the command prompt.

messages.author: 9b8e33e6f9d197ef
messages.subject: Re: Using 'require(RMySQL)' in a rapache page causes warnings.
parts:
I've just discovered this in the documentation:

# Load required DBI and RMySQL packages
REvalOnStartup "library(DBI); library(RMySQL)"

Problem solved. Sorry about the noise.

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Using 'require(RMySQL)' in a rapache page causes warnings.
parts:
The current implementation of error handling in rapache is a hack, and
it's something I intend to fix once I have a better idea. Right now,
both errors and warnings are reported as errors.

Jeff
